breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly defines the factor of safety as n = S_y / σ_avg (yield strength divided by working stress), matching the ground truth. The incorrect definition from the incomplete prompt (n = σ_avg / S_y, with working stress in the numerator) was not repeated. The generated text explicitly states 'the factor of safety against yielding will be computed using the definition n = S_y / σ_avg', which aligns with the ground truth.
